**Bottom line:** Expect tighter lead times and higher pricing; lock in today where risk is highest.

## What changed

- TSMC foundry loading surged 56 % YoY, pushing supply tighter across logic and advanced segments[3].

- Producer price index for semiconductors rose **+32.6 % annualized** over the last three months, fueling price momentum[1].  
- New headlines flag AI‑driven data‑center demand and optical‑network equipment lead‑time stretches beyond 18 months, confirming the upward pressure on component availability[5][6].
